targets.title: Context-dependent memory in two natural environments: on land and underwater.
targets.evidence_quote: Our aim was to replicate the original experiment by Godden & Baddeley [ 1 ] but we failed to achieve this: we did not obtain a statistically significant effect of same versus different context. Our replication was a combination of Godden and Baddeley's Experiments 1 and 2.
